metadata.description: Agent Skills for coding agents, portable across tools implementing the Agent Skills standard.

plugins.name: pr-stacks
plugins.description: Index stacked pull requests across an org and write the message that asks for review.

plugins.name: daily-standup
plugins.description: Build a standup report from what actually happened, with catch-up mode after a gap in activity.

plugins.name: publishing-docs
plugins.description: Simplifies and consolidates technical documents while preserving decisions and evidence, then prepares them for a review audience.

plugins.name: code-documentation-simplification
plugins.description: Simplifies source code comments and docstrings into domain invariants and design intent. Excludes external Markdown documents and RFCs.

plugins.name: adr-authoring
plugins.description: Authors, consolidates, and reviews architecture decision records with explicit invariants, consequences, and historical supersession.
